8.20.17. iLock_Geography.lcf.table_methods.GeoPredBasedTableMethod¶

class iLock_Geography.lcf.table_methods.GeoPredBasedTableMethod(predicate)¶

Base class for table methods based on predicates defined in iLock_Geography.predicate_library.

Example usage:

@arguments(foo=int)
class MyTableMethod(GeoPredBasedTableMethod):
    def __init__(self, foo):
        pred = iLock_Geograpy.predicate_library.SomePred(foo=foo)
        GeoPredBasedTableMethod.__init__(self, pred)

    def arity(self):
        return 2
